handoff.purpose: Manage agent execution in a git worktree, committing results as candidate branches.

symbols.name: CandidateBranch
symbols.note: Dataclass representing a completed task on a dedicated git branch; fields: branch_name, worktree_path, task, completed, error, score.

symbols.name: ShadowShellManager
symbols.note: Spawns an adapter and runs the agent inside a given GitWorktree.

claims.text: Represents a completed task on a dedicated git branch.
claims.why: Dataclass has branch_name, worktree_path, task, completed, error, score; represents a task on a branch as described.

claims.text: Spawns an adapter and runs the agent inside a given GitWorktree.
claims.why: Constructor takes GitWorktreeManager and AgentAdapter; run_task creates worktree and runs adapter session with cwd set to worktree.

claims.text: Executes the agent task inside a new worktree and returns a CandidateBranch.
claims.why: run_task creates a new worktree via worktree_manager.create_worktree, runs task, returns CandidateBranch.

claims.text: The task is the initial one-shot prompt.
claims.why: session_config['prompt'] = task sets the prompt to the task string.

claims.text: Crucially, ``cwd`` is the worktree, and the adapter is required to honor it at process launch.
claims.why: cwd is set to worktree path in session_config, but whether the adapter honors it at process launch is not observable in this chunk.

claims.text: Commit any changes the agent made in the worktree
claims.why: worktree_manager.commit_candidate is called after has_changes check.
The commit message is exactly 'Shadow shell output for task: {task}'.

observations.what: If adapter.create_session raises, session_id may be unbound; finally still awaits adapter.terminate(session_id), which could raise and mask original error.
The code checks has_changes before committing; if there are changes, commit_candidate is called; if commit raises, it's caught and candidate.completed stays False, leading to cleanup.
The adapter.events generator is consumed until SessionEnded; if the session ends without SessionEnded, RuntimeError is raised.
